decision.explanation: The original sources D1S1–D1S18 explicitly state that Charles Enderby is a member of the International Astronautical Federation (IAF), with details about his membership approval and participation. Similarly, D2S1–D2S17 confirm his election as a Fellow of the Royal Society in 1846. Both memberships are directly stated and supported by contextual details. The proposed candidate 'Enderby Whaling Company' is not mentioned in any source as an organization Enderby is a member of, so it is not retained.
